systems.name: 2.1 Working with Cubes & Elements
systems.notes: Master the fundamental building blocks: cubes, elements, pivot points, and basic transformations.
tasks: Create a multi‑element model (e.g., a simple table)
Move/rotate/scale elements using the gizmo and numeric input
Adjust element pivot points for better rotation

systems.name: 2.2 Mesh Modeling (Cubes → Meshes)
systems.notes: Convert cubes to meshes to gain vertex‑level control.
tasks: Convert a cube to a mesh
Practise by modeling a simple vase or bottle

systems.name: 2.3 UV Mapping Basics
systems.notes: Understand how textures wrap around 3D geometry.
tasks: Manually adjust UV islands to prevent stretching
Export a UV template for painting
